rows.name: spacer
rows.description: spacer controls the visibility of the content. If spacer is true, all of the other properties are ignored and the content is not showing. This is used for cells that are empty.

rows.name: alignment
rows.description: controls the alignment of the content of the Cell.

rows.name: tagsProps
rows.type: it is an array of Tags properties. This property is used only when the type is tags, otherwise it is ignored. | type | tags

rows.name: listData
rows.type: the properties of the list of buttons to be displayed in the Multiple ActionsFlyout Menu. This property is used only when the type is menu, otherwise it is ignored. | type | menu

rows.name: contentSlot
rows.type: Dynamic content of the cell. This property is used only when the type is slot, otherwise it is ignored. | type | slot
